limitations: Exactly two indistinguishable tokens; complete bipartite simple unweighted hosts with both parts at least three; no higher-token, integral critical-group, or weighted result; publication-priority uncertainty remains.
scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic invariant-space proof for all m,n >= 3; finite exact and modular checks corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem. Integrality and algebraic connectivity were previously known and are excluded from the new claim.
title: Exact Laplacian spectrum and spanning-tree count of two-token complete-bipartite graphs
